# Pregnancy Week Tracker — llms.txt
# Free pregnancy week-by-week tracker — https://www.pregnancyweektracker.com
# Privacy policy last updated: October 2026

## What is Pregnancy Week Tracker?

Pregnancy Week Tracker (pregnancyweektracker.com) is a free, browser-based pregnancy companion. Enter your last menstrual period (LMP) date and get your gestational age in completed weeks and days, trimester, estimated due date, baby size comparisons, developmental notes, and prep tips. No sign-up required. Operator: Vinod Isaac. Contact: hello@pregnancyweektracker.com.

## How weeks are counted

Gestational age is counted from LMP in completed weeks and days (e.g. 143 days = 20 weeks + 3 days → “20w 3d”). Week guide pages are capped at week 42. Pregnancy dates are stored in the browser (sessionStorage/localStorage) and are not placed in page URLs.

## Trimesters (this site)

- Trimester 1: weeks 1–13
- Trimester 2: weeks 14–27
- Trimester 3: weeks 28+

## ACOG term categories (educational)

- Early term: 37w0d–38w6d
- Full term: 39w0d–40w6d
- Late term: 41w0d–41w6d
- Post-term: 42w0d+

## Key features

- Pregnancy week calculator from LMP (or due date)
- Due date estimate (Naegele-style: LMP + 280 days, cycle-adjusted)
- Week pages for weeks 1–42
- Baby size comparisons (fruit/object references; illustrative)
- Kick counter and contraction timer
- Checklists and guides
- Free to use; supported by AdSense and Amazon affiliate links

## Privacy (honest summary)

- Calculations run client-side in the browser
- Device storage keys may include: pwtSavedLMP, pwtSavedDue, pwtSavedCycle, pwtChecklistState, kcHits, ctHistoryList, pwt_week_notes
- Third parties: Google Analytics 4 (G-LVGV89T5QG), Google AdSense, Sentry (errors; replays off), OpenMoji/image CDNs, Amazon Associates
- Full policy: https://www.pregnancyweektracker.com/privacy.html
- Clear data via browser site-data controls or localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear();

## What problem does it solve?

Gives expectant parents a fast week-by-week reference without requiring an account. It is educational only — not medical advice. Clinician dating (especially early ultrasound) takes priority.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How do I calculate how many weeks pregnant I am?
A: Enter the first day of your LMP. The site shows completed weeks and days (e.g. “You’re 20 weeks and 3 days pregnant”) and opens the matching week guide page (capped at 42).

Q: How is the due date calculated?
A: Roughly LMP + 280 days (40 weeks), with optional cycle-length adjustment. Doctors may change the date after a dating scan.

Q: Is Pregnancy Week Tracker free?
A: Yes. The site is free and is supported by advertising and affiliate links, disclosed in the privacy policy and on product blocks.

Q: Does it send my pregnancy dates to analytics?
A: Dates are kept in browser storage and are not put in URLs. Analytics and ads still receive normal page-view technical data; GA is configured to redact lmp/due/cycle query parameters if they ever appear.
